query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Calderwood . What is the lowest price anyone charges for the 2 x 9.5L pack of Calderwood water?

Before answering, open every listing in the search results, including any on later pages, and check the relevant option on each one. Do not stop early because a listing looks unpromising from its search-result price. Base the answer only on listings you have opened, and say how many you opened.

result.final: The lowest price for the 2 x 9.5L pack of Calderwood water is $17.36, charged by Bramley Trading. I opened all 15 listings in the search results (across 2 pages) and checked each one for the 2 x 9.5L pack option. 10 listings had this option available, and 5 listings did not offer this pack size.
